_readme: All resume text lives here. Edit this file and push to GitHub; the live site updates automatically. Each job shows its 'key' bullets (3 or 4 is best) and its 'tags' (the skills used in that role). 'More about this role' opens a pop-up with 'creative', 'highlights', 'earlier_roles', and any 'photos'. Work items with "featured": true show first; the rest appear under 'See all work'. The AI chat reads everything in this file, shown or not. 'looking_for' lists the roles you want; it shows in the top section and the AI chat uses it. 'pillars' fill the 'What I do' section. A job's 'areas' list shows what goes into each part of the role (e.g. Creative, Technology, Marketing).
_work_help: Each item in 'work' is one card. Optional: 'image' (a picture you put in public/work/, e.g. "/work/poster.jpg"), 'video' (a YouTube or Vimeo link; YouTube also gives the card its picture), 'link' (any web page), 'role', 'collaborators', 'details'. 'category' is one name or a list of names from: Web design, Product design, Project design, Print design, Marketing, Video, Events, Storytelling, Collaborations, Technology, AI.
_photos_help: To add pictures to a job's pop-up, put the files in public/work/ and list them in that job's 'photos', e.g. {"image": "/work/faze-lookbook.jpg", "caption": "Spring lookbook, 2015"}. A YouTube or Vimeo link works too: {"video": "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=...", "caption": "..."}. Use JPG or PNG about 1600px wide and under 500 KB. The first photo is shown large.
name: Herbert Gracia
role: Creative Director · Art Director · Brand Builder
tagline: I take brands from idea to market. I co-founded two apparel brands and grew one to acquisition, designing every product, store, and campaign and selling direct to consumers and to retail and wholesale accounts. For 21 years I've also led creative, technology, marketing, communications, and PR at the University of San Francisco's Fromm Institute.
about: My strength is connecting brand strategy, creative thinking, and marketing with execution, from concept and product development through campaign, production, digital platforms, sales, and customer experience.

My background spans brand strategy, creative direction, art direction, integrated marketing, visual storytelling, video, product development, manufacturing, sales, technology, AI, and experiential marketing. I also use AI and generative AI in campaign development, content creation, audience messaging, research, social media marketing, and creative workflows.
